audit.whatIsWrong: diffRating 7.5/10 against a 52.06% Gangplank win rate over 436 games.
audit.why: Quinn owns levels 1-3 hard, then the lane is even and finally Gangplank's — a 6/10 lane, not 7.5.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart said 'Skill' at level 1 while the early text says 'Levels 1-3 are hers', and gave Quinn both item stages while whys[5] and whys[6] say the Sheen spike and two items are where you out-burst and one-shot her.
audit.why: A keg-less Gangplank cannot answer Harrier-marked autos plus Blinding Assault; a Sheen-empowered Parrrley into a chained keg deletes a squishy marksman frame.
audit.corrected: One group: L1 Quinn 4/10, First item Gangplank 7/10, 2+ items Gangplank 8/10. Levels 2-3 stay Quinn, 4-5 and 6 stay Skill.

audit.whatIsWrong: Vault is described as knocking YOU back and 'resetting', and the blind is attributed to Vault in three places ('Vault (Dash/Blind)', 'Fight into her blind'). Both are wrong.
audit.why: Riot's E text: 'Quinn dashes to an enemy... Upon reaching the target, she leaps off the target, briefly interrupting it, and lands near her maximum Attack Range away from the target.' She displaces herself, not you, there is no reset, and the interrupt is brief. The blind is Blinding Assault (Q) — 'mark an enemy and hinder its vision', 11/10.5/10/9.5/9 at 1025 range. Telling a Gangplank to fear a knockback that does not exist, while missing the ability that actually makes his autos miss, misprices every trade.
audit.corrected: Vault restated as her 12s in-and-out escape with a brief interrupt; the blind assigned to Blinding Assault (Q, 11s, 1025) and made the reason not to open autos.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer refers to Quinn as 'he'/'him' in the trade lines and don'ts.
audit.why: Quinn is female and the content layer uses 'she'.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed in tradeGood, tradeBad, do's, don'ts, breakdown.trading and report[3].

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are hers and you have to accept it. Her Vault (E) dashes in, knocks you back, and resets if it connects, so every keg you try to set up gets interrupted, and her Harrier passive marks you for a bonus-damage empowered auto she can land and kite away from before you answer. Do not try to trade — last-hit at max Parrrley (Q) range, never walk into Vault range to place a keg, and hold Remove Scurvy (W) to cleanse the Vault knockback effects and heal the poke back when she over-commits.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are hers and you have to accept it. Her Vault (E, 12s) dashes in, briefly interrupts whatever you are doing, then leaps her back out to attack range, and Harrier marks you for a bonus-damage auto she lands and walks away from. Blinding Assault (Q, 11s, 1025 range) is the blind — eat it and your autos miss, so never open a trade into it. Last-hit at max Parrrley range and hold Remove Scurvy (W) to cleanse the slow and heal the poke back.

notes: Two packet name flags ('Powder Kegs', 'Use Cannon Barrage') are false positives. The real defect was mechanical: Vault was described as knocking Gangplank back and resetting — it does neither, she leaps herself back to attack range — and the blind was attributed to Vault instead of Blinding Assault (Q) in three separate strings. dosFull[2].t still reads 'Q-cleanse her slows' (19 chars, under the applier's 25-char skip) and needs a manual fix: the cleanse is Remove Scurvy (W).
